name: Jainism
summary: A tradition of the Indian subcontinent centred on ahimsa and the teaching of the tirthankaras, organised into the Digambara and Svetambara branches.

founded.note: Tradition itself holds a lineage of earlier tirthankaras; that view is tradition-internal

adherents.basis: 4.45 m in India per the 2011 census, plus a small diaspora. Not enumerated by Pew.
